：超越百级的祭品（：超越百级的祭品（第22页）一个多时辰后，两位大人来到寝宫，见大王呆呆地看见桌子上那包裹。东方乐走过去打开一看，吓了一大跳；西门大人凑近看，惊愕万分。“哼，”将有冰道，“我真陶阳某种人。”然后走了。独留张叶在房间。独自坐在房间的张叶苦笑，将有冰说的讨厌某人就是自己吧。他摸了摸脑袋，真搞不懂自己有什么让人讨厌的，他自我感觉良好。“节操呢？你不是说在这个世界生存要有节操的吗？你刚才那一瞬间是不是把节操全丢地上了，给我捡起来！”张铮指着现在正侧头望着窗外吹口哨的、心虚的李朝。宁岳点了点头，随后又看向通灵峰的晋阳以及铸剑峰的尘枯，突然，宁岳朗声道。老刘笑了一下，说：什么都瞒不过你！这些人过去，属于什么性质，待遇如何，我该怎么向职工说明。宁岳一怔，四分之一？宁岳看了看那光芒闪烁的庞大身躯，面色有些发苦，也幸亏他是荒体，不然他一定不会同意这么截取通道之灵的躯体。宁岳眼中闪过一丝凝重，虽然不知晓那尊度之中的实力，但是从这天族记忆中得知天族对其也是极为敬仰，甚至是臣服于那尊度之下。“睡吧，我会一直陪在你身边的。”这声音，比梦梦的声音还要甜，这是陆云最后的想法，紧接着，陆云便昏死过去，人事不知。李朝望着身边的人，本来没什么的，结果看见两个猪头在自己旁边站着，当时吓了一跳，仔细看了一下，才发现这俩猪头就是鼻青脸肿的秦煌和李休。玄墨卿低头想了一下：“没有了。”适合天外作战的战兵，已经是帝品以上了，这在五方大陆是绝无仅有的，她提出来的时候心里都惴惴不安。

: A Sacrifice Beyond Level 100 (: A Sacrifice Beyond Level 100 (Page 22)) More than an hour later, the two adults came to the palace and saw the king blankly seeing the package on the table. Dongfang Le walked over and opened it, and was shocked; Lord Ximen looked closer, Shocked. "Huh," Jiang Youbing said, "I am really a kind of Tao Yang." Then he left. Zhang Ye, who was sitting alone in the room, smiled bitterly. He touched his head and couldn't figure out what he was talking about. It's so annoying. He feels good about himself. "What about moral integrity? Didn't you say that you need to have moral integrity to survive in this world? Did you throw all your moral integrity on the ground at that moment? Pick it up for me!" Zhang Zheng pointed and blew while looking sideways out of the window. Li Chao was whistled and guilty. Ning Yue nodded, and then looked at Jin Yang from Tongling Peak and Chen Ku from Zhu Jian Peak. Suddenly, Ning Yue smiled loudly and said: I can't hide anything from you, what kind of people they were, and how they were treated. How should I explain it to the staff? Ning Yue was startled, a quarter? Ning Yue looked at the huge body with flashes of light, and his face was a little bitter. Fortunately, he was a waste body, otherwise he would not agree to intercept the body of the channel spirit. A flash of light flashed in Ning Yue's eyes. Silk is solemn, although he does not know the strength of that Zundu, but from the memory of this Celestial Clan, he knows that the Celestial Clan also respects him very much, and even surrenders to that Zundu. "Go to sleep, I will always be by your side." This voice is louder than Mengmeng's voice. It's sweet, this was Lu Yun's last thought. Immediately afterwards, Lu Yun passed out and didn't know who was going on. Li Chao looked at the people around him. It was nothing, but he saw two pig heads standing next to him. He was startled at that time, and after taking a closer look, he realized. These two pig heads were Qin Huang and Li Xiu, who had a bruised nose and a swollen face. Xuan Moqing lowered her head and thought for a moment: "No more." The soldiers suitable for fighting in the outer world are already emperor grade or above, which is unique in Wufang Continent. She felt uneasy when she mentioned it.
